profile.headline: Senior Software Development Engineer
profile.summary:
Sr. Software Engineer with professional experience in Software architecture, engineering, and designing. 9+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance distributed systems. Proven track record of, modernizing legacy frameworks, securing multi-tenant platforms and optimizing performance. Mentored engineers and interns, significantly enhancing team productivity and fostering technical growth. Recognized for leading cross-functional teams, driving architecture decisions, and delivering measurable business impact.

I am determined, hard working, self motivated Engineer who is always excited about new challenges,  ready to learn new things and improve my skill sets. 

•  Familiarity with all stages of the development lifecycle, including requirement analysis, design, development, testing, and maintenance.
• Good understanding of Object Oriented Development, Data Structures and Algorithms.
•  Proficient in core Java Enterprise technologies such as Spring, Hibernate, JSP, Servlets, Java Web Services, Java SOAP, JDBC, Java Collection Framework, Java Session Management.
•  Executed large scale systems as a developer, with an emphasis on designing scalable, secure, and robust services in Java/J2EE
•  Deep understanding of design pattern such as Singleton, Data Access Object, Factory Pattern, MVC pattern
•  Strong commitment to team environment dynamics with the ability to contribute expertise and follow leadership directives at appropriate time
•  Microsoft Certified Professional: Programming in HTML5 with JavaScript and CSS3, Oracle certified Database Administrator Introduction to Oracle 9i: SQL
•  Well versed with working in development methodologies like Agile (Scrum), Waterfall, TDD.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Environment: Java 17, Spring Boot, XO, Kafka, Restful Web Services, AWS Container, GitHub, Bitbucket, TeamCity, Jira, Agile, Confluence.
• Re-architected and optimized DS Framework for public cloud, improving scalability, reliability and boosting performance by 35% across multi-tenant environments.
• Spearheaded development of the DS Repeatability feature to process new audit trails & modified scramble rules, cutting re-execution time from over 23 hours to minutes.
• Architected and led the cross-org modernization of legacy AOD and OTS orchestration systems, replacing them with a distributed, cloud-ready framework that eliminated single points of failure and removed COS dependencies by introducing asynchronous uptake components, delivering a scalable, fault-tolerant solution.
• Influenced cross-functional framework enhancement decisions by aligning architecture, design, and delivery strategies across multiple platform teams.
• Enhanced a high-performance RESTful external data framework (XDF) invocation and improving resiliency and supported 10M+ weekly requests across Workday’s ecosystem,
enabling secure, scalable integrations through OAuth-based authentication and transactional APIs.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate XDF with core systems including Workday ML Engine, Payroll, and Google Maps, ensuring seamless data flow, business continuity, and enterprise-grade reliability across critical workflows.
• Involved in securing the Subtenant architecture, designing isolation techniques that protected data across 15,000+ subtenants and contributed to a revenue impact.
• Mentored and guided three engineers and interns through design and implementation of distributed fws, leading design reviews, improving code quality, and fostering technical growth and ownership of complex features.
• Provided 24*7 cross-functional production support and incident resolution across core frameworks and partner products, ensuring high availability, platform reliability.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Teamwork · Scalable Web Applications · API Development · Software Development · google guava · Communication · RESTful WebServices · Team Leadership · Gradle · Core Java · Team Mentoring

positions.title: Application Engineer IV
positions.description:
Environment: Java 8/J2EE, Spring Boot, Restful Web Services, Maven, STS, Eclipse, GitHub, CICD, Jenkins, Jira, Agile, Confluence.
• Designed and Implemented eligibility service to provide financing offers to eligible consumers by evaluating lightweight risk and compliance strategies within 0.2s.
• Coded risk segment capabilities in Java for consumers’ evaluation in eligibility to decide needs of the bureau data to make final decision during underwriting check.
• Integrated with the StoredValueServ to deny Pay Later products offers to the consumers whose PayPal account balance is negative using Java and Spring Rest.
• Created Async data persistence step to fetch and filter credit decision making data for auditing, exploratory, and predictive data analysis to take better product decisions.
• Applied knowledge of Object-oriented principles, data structures to develop innovative solutions for bureau check and maintained high quality of the real-world products.
• Enhanced codebase and infrastructure to incorporate millions of calls in an hour and reduced request timeouts.
• Help rules team with offline data store lookup optimization to push Risk service’s technology forward with respect to performance, reliability, and functionality.
• Maintained code coverage standards using Junit, regression testing and SonarQube, along with Jenkins pipelines to run integration tests build.
• Maintained Risk platform’s health by resolving live issues and used in-house monitoring tools to analyze data for triaging, root-cause analysis and infrastructure performance.
positions.insights: Skills: Teamwork · Scalable Web Applications · API Development · Software Development · google guava · Communication · RESTful WebServices · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · Gradle · Core Java

positions.title: Software dev
positions.description:
Environment: Java/J2EE, Struts2, EJB, HTML, CSS, Spring, JSP, Open JPA, Oracle 12c, Restful & SOAP Web Serv, JMS, Agile, WebSphere, Confluence, Bamboo, Jenkins, JIRA, SVN.
• Scaled n-tier software application to support large number of users and conferred with stakeholders to identify new functionality to prioritize tasks, design and implement.
• Architected, designed and produced the REST service to provide the online notarization functionality and reduced application processing time for hundreds of applicants.
• Generated WSDL to consume and store the criminal records of the applicants in proper format to make background check decision in distributed environment.
• Developed server-side components of transaction-based web service in Java 8 by integrating different services to get sex offender and criminal history related records within 1.5s.
• Build new experiences and improved existing codebase by Implementing data layer in Spring Hibernate to replace existing legacy system.
• Provided 24*7 technical support to resolve production issues and maintain highly scalable and secure services used by the CJIS (Internal stakeholders) and NCJI Agencies.
positions.insights: Skills: API Development · Software Development · Communication · RESTful WebServices · WebSphere Application Server · Team Leadership · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · Core Java

positions.title: Java Web Developer
positions.description:
Environment: Java/J2EE, HTML, CSS, Spring, Angular Js, Bootstrap, CSS, Restful web service, Oracle 12c.
• Involved in creation of Low-Level Design including sequence and class diagrams to comprehend the existing architecture.
• Designed, migrated Help Cust support modules’ front-end to new tech stack, handled data streams with RxJs, integrated SignalR for real-time push notification form server.
• Developed server-side REST Services to extract customer related data from database using Spring concrete principles laid down by several design patterns such as singleton.
• Crossed collaborate with multiple teams to improve design and build solutions to indicate fraud transactions using geolocation, IP add. and other elements of the cardholder.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Environment: Java, JDBC, Spring MVC, JSP, Hibernate, HTML, CSS, jQuery, AJAX, JavaScript, Oracle 11g, Maven, TFS, Waterfall methodology
•	Designed a database schema and created trigger, sequences, views, the data dictionary with primary keys, foreign keys, and dependencies in MySQL for equipment repairs.
•	Programmed a website which managed the resources, keep track and notify the customers about their status by generating automated emails in a timely manner
•	Implemented Integrated Security system to avoid frauds, also offered an add-on for the search functionality based on Stock Keeping Unit (SKU), Equipment type, IMEI numbers
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · Core Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Developed a government Tax Management System using Hibernate to provide convenient way to carry out various taxation processes both for the taxpayers and tax Administrative Officers.
•  Built the Debt and Enforcement module for the Integrated Tax Management System (ITMS) which managed the legal actions towards the irregular taxpayers including automatic notices
•  Generated summarization reports by developing join queries to provide the status of the debt waiver and debt write-off cases based on Tax station and Region wise with PostgreSQL
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Spring Framework · Core Java
